integrity: Theorem supplies complete explicit proof; standalone checker tests finite mod-two homology and exact signed Lefschetz characters, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only \(m\ge3\) complete petals glued at a single vertex, \(t\ge3\), and \(s_i\ge t\).
The homotopy wedge is nonequivariant; homology modules are integral and equivariant.
Results for arbitrary block graphs or larger clique intersections are not asserted.
Implicit coverage in unindexed literature remains possible; independent validation not performed.
title: Separated sphere dimensions and integral petal symmetries of clique-free windmills
